title: Sierre-Zinal — participants and registration status
claims: The participants page links 'REGISTRATION – SIERRE-ZINAL 53rd EDITION' and marks that registration as closed.
At the time of access the same page listed no registration page for the 2027 edition.
The same page describes the junior race as Chandolin–Zinal for 10–17 year-olds.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网英文参赛者页。页面仍以 2026 第 53 届为主体；2027 只显示日期，没有报名入口或费用说明。

claimVerification.note: 页面报名区只有第 53 届链接，未见 2027 报名页或 2027 费用。
